summary: Partial fix: the candidate regression suite passes, but TransformersAutoMultimodalProcessor's real non-audio async path calls _apply_hf_processor directly and emits no mm_processor_seconds observation.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression suite on recorded base; 7/7 failed, reproducing absent metrics and missing observation hooks.
Candidate's regression suite; 7/7 passed, including bounded HTTP media and direct process_mm_data override cases.
Actual TransformersAuto async override with a 20 ms _apply_hf_processor interval; request completed but collector recorded zero processor observations.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reproduced defect is CPU-side tokenizer-manager instrumentation and requires no model weights or GPU execution.

remaining_counterexamples: TransformersAutoMultimodalProcessor.process_mm_data_async directly invokes _apply_hf_processor on the non-audio path; the candidate wraps process_mm_data only, so mm_processor_seconds remains absent for this real specialized async path.

The design still does not enforce processor timing around process_mm_data_async as a whole; specialized async implementations that invoke processor-specific helpers instead of process_mm_data can bypass the metric.
remaining_limitations: No model weights were available or required; model-specific semantic correctness was not evaluated.
No GPU or distributed serving validation was performed because the failing contract occurs in CPU-side preprocessing before model execution.
No native sources changed in the candidate, so native rebuild validation was not applicable.
